$comment: EA-3 VocabularyContract golden for agent ontology v1 (agt:). FILED NOWHERE YET — publication to the graph is CA-1/S9. This is the frozen-vocab source of truth the S5 serializer + assertAgentSparql self-check are pinned against: the five agent-as-subject classes, their required predicates, and the closed toolAccess enum. Shape-modeled on the wf: vocab (src/workflow/vocab.ts REQUIRED_*_PREDICATES) since no prior mem: golden exists in this worktree. Substrate-blind by construction: NO CRDT term, NO gen-2 Perception/Memory/Judgment class — Memory/Song are POINTERS only (agt:recallRef / agt:songRef).

classes.comment: A stable registered Agent identity carried by an Agent Meaningful Object and independent of mutable model or prompt revisions. THE memory-witness: its subject IRI urn:sophia:agent:{agentId} byte-matches L0's observer_iri. Persists across sandbox lifetimes.
One conversational session, owned by an agent and a user (cognito sub).
One journal entry as METADATA + tool-usage POINTERS only. Carries NO message body. Memory/Song referenced by pointer (agt:recallRef / agt:songRef).
A coarse access posture the agent holds.
A tool the agent used or DECLARED. A declared-but-unused tool (toolStatus=declared, e.g. grow_interface) is a demand-signal subject.

pointers.$comment: Cross-vocabulary references emitted as OPAQUE IRIs only — the agt: fold imports NO gen-2 Perception/Memory/Judgment schema.
pointers.agt:recallRef: an opaque IRI into the Memory store (no schema import)
pointers.agt:songRef: an opaque IRI into the Song narrative (no schema import)
pointers.agt:usedTool: an agt:Tool subject minted in this same fold

forbidden.$comment: Tokens the fold MUST NEVER emit — the substrate-blind + no-body-leak guarantee.

deferred.$comment: What S5 does NOT do — these are CA-1/S9.
deferred.ea3Filing: publishing this VocabularyContract to the coordination graph is S9
deferred.shaclValidation: a real RDF/SHACL validator is a Vera-gated dep / the S9 real-infra gate; S5 uses an in-process substring self-check only
